nova:config:
resource_pack:
  auto_upload:
    enabled: false
  prompt:
    message: <gradient:aqua:blue>Nova Resource Pack</gradient>
    force: true
    enableForceBypassPermission: false
    enablePromptBypassPermission: false
  generation:
    description: Nova (%s asset pack(s), %s base pack(s))
    base_packs: []
    compression_level: -1
    in_memory: true
    font:
      moved_font_blacklist: []
    whitelisted_file_types: []
    resource_filters: []
    minecraft_assets_source: github
  force_uniform_font: false
  japanese_glyph_variants: false
entity_render_distance:
  min: 1
  max: 6
  default: 4
overlay:
  actionbar:
    enabled: true
  bossbar:
    enabled: true
    amount: 20
    send_bars_after_resource_pack_loaded: false
    invisible_colors: []
    vanilla_bars:
      positioning:
        margin_top: 14
        margin_bottom: 0
waila:
  enabled: true
  positioning:
    margin_top: 5
    margin_bottom: 5
    above:
    - type: index
      index: 0
    below: []
  pos_update_interval: 1
  data_update_interval: 5
  blacklisted_blocks: []
world:
  block_breaking:
    break_cooldown: 5
  format:
    region_backups: true
    compression: zstd
network:
  parallel_ticking: true
  energy:
    tick_delay: 1
    max_complexity: -1
    default_transfer_rate: -1
  item:
    tick_delay: 20
    max_complexity: -1
    default_transfer_rate: -1
    channel_amount: 4
  fluid:
    tick_delay: 1
    max_complexity: -1
    default_transfer_rate: -1
    channel_amount: 4
performance:
  load_char_sizes_on_startup: false
  drop_excess_on_ground: true
  block_break_effects: true
  item_stack_legacy_conversion: true
use_metric_prefixes: false
update_reminder:
  enabled: true
  interval: 12000
debug:
  watch_chunk_reloads: false
  allow_craft_result_overwrite: false
  skip_pack_tasks: []
  logging:
    initializer: false
    biome_injections: false
    registry_freeze: false
